features: 【SMALL SCREEN TO BIG SCREEN MIRRORING】: Transform your smartphone, tablet or laptop screen into a larger viewing experience with the AUSHA M9 Plus Wireless Display Dongle. Wirelessly mirror compatible HD videos, photos, music, presentations, games and other supported content to an HDMI-equipped TV, monitor or projector. Ideal for home entertainment, business meetings, office presentations, education, training and everyday screen sharing.

【4K ULTRA HD & FULL HD 1080P DISPLAY】: Enjoy detailed and vibrant visuals with support for up to 4K Ultra HD resolution (3840 × 2160) on compatible displays, along with Full HD 1080P output. The default resolution is 1080P. Mirror or cast compatible content from your smartphone, tablet, PC or Mac to a large screen for an immersive viewing and presentation experience.

【MULTI-PROTOCOL & WIDE COMPATIBILITY】: Supports popular wireless display and media-sharing technologies including Miracast, AirPlay and DLNA, with compatibility for supported Android, iOS, Windows and macOS devices. Works with compatible smartphones, tablets and laptops from popular brands such as Samsung, Sony, iPhone and others. Compatibility and available functions may vary depending on the device, operating system, application and wireless protocol.

【STABLE 2.4GHz WIRELESS CONNECTION】: Designed for convenient wireless screen sharing using 2.4GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n). The M9 Plus eliminates the need for a long HDMI cable between your source device and display, providing a cleaner and more flexible setup. Suitable for video sharing, web browsing, photo viewing, presentations, live camera sharing and other compatible media applications.

【EASY 3-STEP PLUG & PLAY SETUP】: Get started without complicated installation. Step 1: Connect the M9 Plus to the HDMI port of your TV, monitor or projector. Step 2: Connect the dongle to a suitable 5V/1A or higher USB power supply. Step 3: Connect your compatible smartphone, tablet or computer using the supported wireless display method and start sharing. No separate driver installation is required, making it convenient for home, office, school, meetings and travel.

【Note】Android device could compatible with most Apps; but some device isn't compatible with Subscription Apps, like Netflix, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, Disney +, etc. Our wireless HDMI dongle can't transfer pictures to TV as these Apps have "HDCP" video copyrights protection.
